exposure: History of other illicit substance abuse
outcome: Persistent opioid use (defined as consistent prescription opioid use in the year following delivery)
cohort: 80,127 opioid-naïve women who underwent cesarean delivery
finding: Only a small percentage (0.36%) of opioid-naïve women became persistent opioid users after cesarean delivery, with pre-existing conditions like substance abuse history, mental health conditions, and certain pain conditions being significant predictors.
